# PeopleSoft User Group

PeopleSoft User Group is no longer being held but has been replaced by the
Scouting America Fiscals Forum.

Look for updates on when the [Scouting America Fiscals
Forum](https://www.scouting.org/bsa-fiscals-forum/) is held in your email.
